Overview

content_blocks.text: This PPN applies to all central government departments, their executive agencies and non-departmental public bodies (collectively referred to as 'in-scope organisations'). Other contracting authorities (e.g. local government and the wider public sector) are strongly recommended to apply the measures set out in this PPN (i.e. PPN 10/14).
heading_path: The plan for public procurement of food and catering
Overview

content_blocks.text: The PPN outlines the approach in-scope organisations should take when buying food and catering services, including: committing to food procurement that is compliant with the Government Buying Standard for Food and Catering (GBSF), and; proactive contract management by working with suppliers to ensure responsible sourcing which is compliant with the requirements of the Government Buying Standard.
